outcome: Umbilical cord plasma DHA in LPC and PC fractions
Placental free carnitine and acylcarnitine metabolites
Placental protein expression of enzymes involved in beta-oxidation and esterification pathways
MFSD2a protein expression in syncytiotrophoblast microvillous (MVM) and basal (BM) membranes
OCTN2 protein expression in syncytiotrophoblast microvillous (MVM) and basal (BM) membranes
cohort: The study included mother-placenta-baby triads from women with normal and obese pre-pregnancy BMI.
finding: Maternal obesity was associated with sex-specific alterations in umbilical cord plasma DHA levels and placental fatty acid oxidation, esterification, and transport capacity, with distinct impacts observed in male and female offspring.
cross-section timing: At birth, using mother-placenta-baby triads and umbilical cord plasma.
